title: Madhu — Product Designer
description: Madhumita Krishnan — product designer with a background in architecture and brand strategy. Curious about how design helps our mind flow, in order to simplify complex workflows.

brands.title: Brands that have liked my thinking
brands.sub: I worked in brand strategy for 3+ years

projects.name: Driftwood
projects.outcome: Repositioned and rebuilt driftwood.sh in 18 hours — researched, coded, and shipped; clients grew from 1 to 4.

media.alt: The new driftwood.sh homepage in motion

projects.name: Spotify Mix redesign
projects.outcome: Rebuilt Spotify's mixing flow around listener confidence — ratings rose 2.6 → 3.7 out of 5, and 11 of 11 testers preferred it.

media.alt: The redesigned Spotify Mix screen, animating through a transition edit

projects.name: Budgeting app
projects.outcome: Designed a budgeting app around decisions instead of reports — SUS scores rose 47%, from 55 to 81, across two rounds of testing.

media.alt: Stack home screen — ask before you spend, with quick insights

projects.name: Atlantic Health
projects.outcome: Found the messaging that doubled physician referral intent — 16% → 32% — for a $65M proton therapy center.

about.title: Architecture taught me systems. Brand taught me story. Product is where they meet.
about.body: I'm Madhumita Krishnan, a product designer in New York with a background in architecture and brand strategy. I care about the moment a complex thing becomes obvious — in a building, a campaign, or a screen.
